text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I just suddenly got this overwhelming 
craving to eat it... Ehehe☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
But you know, it's fine! Being this hungry 
just makes me feel like I can reach the 
goal even faster!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
All riiiight! I'm gonna come back in 1st 
place and eat a buuunch of food!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Hishi Akebono seems to be full of 
fighting spirit!
